messages:
Priya Kapoor: Reminder: change window tonight 22:00 PT. We're targeting v2.3.1. Starting prompt/eval gate now. If gate passes we promote at 22:10; otherwise we'll consider route-level pins.

DeployBot: Eval gate initiated for v2.3.1. Running suites: summarizer, search-rerank, chat-safety. Expected runtime ~7m.

qa-bot: finished. Highlights: summarizer +0.4% (good); search-rerank recall@10 -2.8% (threshold -1.0%) -> FAIL; chat-safety no regressions. Failure concentrated on tail queries with unusual punctuation and trailing emojis. Top buckets: noisy user input, length 80-150 chars.

Rory Zhang: That's pretty specific. v2.3.1 included a tokenizer change (strip-emoji=true) and a minor candidate reweight in reranker. Suspect tokenizer trimming overzealous for noisy text.

Nina Patel: If rerank fails we risk search relevance in discovery product. Product Erin, any tolerance for partial rollout?

Product Erin: We need search stability for top queries. If only edge/noisy inputs regress, maybe route-split: keep /search/default on v2.2.9 and let v2.3.1 handle non-search routes. But discovery product uses /search/default heavily. Would prefer pinning only traffic that matches noisy pattern if routing supports it.

eng-bot: Routing supports header-based and query-pattern routing. We can pin based on a lightweight regexp match on query payload. Example dry-run: `/deploy pin-route --route /search/default --match "payload.query =~ /[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}|:emoji:]/u" --to v2.2.9 --until manual`

Rory Zhang: Can we avoid building a complex match right now? Simpler: pin entire /search/default to v2.2.9 until we ship a fix. Ops cost minimal.

DeployBot: Pin dry-run available. Use `/deploy pin-route apply 4432109999 --route /search/default --to v2.2.9` to apply.

Priya Kapoor: Let's do a conservative rollout: pin /search/default to v2.2.9, promote v2.3.1 to all other routes at 25% initial traffic, monitor 20m. If no additional regressions, move to 100%. Agreed?

Rory Zhang: I'll run a quick bisect to confirm tokenizer is culprit. Starting binary search across commits that touched tokenization/normalization. Sampling 1k failing queries. ETA ~30m.

qa-bot: Created ticket RESEARCH-451 with eval diffs + reproducible examples and run ids: eval_run/2026-03-21-443210. Linked artifacts: https://internal/RESEARCH-451.

eng-bot: Pin dry-run log: OK. No infra scaling needed. Applying now if Priya approves.

Priya Kapoor: Apply pin. `/deploy pin-route apply 4432109999 --route /search/default --to v2.2.9` :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Pin applied. /search/default -> v2.2.9 pinned until manual unpin. v2.3.1 proceeding with staged rollout (25% global for non-search routes).

qa-bot: Updating release notes draft: "v2.3.1 promoted. /search/default pinned to v2.2.9 due to reranker regression on noisy queries. Investigation ticket RESEARCH-451 opened. Plan: revert tokenizer strip-emoji change in candidate build and re-run eval gate."

Rory Zhang: Bisect results: narrowing to commit 8f2a7c (tokenizer: normalize-emoji -> removed placeholder tokens). Repro locally on rtx6000 with failing cases. Will propose revert patch within 3h.

Product Erin: ETA acceptable. Any user-facing impact? How many sessions affected?

qa-bot: Telemetry: ~0.8% of search traffic includes noisy emoji patterns; of those, quality drop noticeable in ~60% of examples. Global user-facing impact estimated <0.5% of overall search impressions for now due to pin.

Nina Patel: Ops will keep the pin and watch routing logs. If we see unexpected error spikes, we'll rollback the entire promotion.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks all. Rory, once you have a candidate patch, please run the eval gate (use the same prompt-suite) and post results here. If gate passes, we'll unpin via `/deploy pin-route remove 4432109999 --route /search/default` and finish rollout.

Rory Zhang: Will do. Reopening thread if anything changes.
